./roadmap-plans.md:411:**Store** (`src/pypeeker/storage/transaction_store.py`): `TransactionStore.save` writes header line + edit lines + at most one rename line. `load` (line 58) dispatches on one condition — `if data.get("op") == EditOp.RENAME_FILE.value` → `FileRenameEntry`, `else` → `from_dict(EditEntry, data)`. Because `models/serialize.py:from_dict` only fills keys present in the data and lets defaults apply, an unrecognised `op` line hitting the `else` branch would raise a raw `TypeError` for the missing required `start`/`end`/`old`/`new`, not a clean refusal. `LoadedTransaction` is a 3-tuple, destructured at seven sites: `applier.py:61`, `applier.py:164`, `cli.py:1199`, `cli.py:1228`, `cli.py:1251`, `refactor/registry.py:133` (`load_transaction`), `refactor/visibility_ops.py:368`.
./roadmap-plans.md:443:`LoadedTransaction` becomes a frozen dataclass (`header`, `edits`, `file_rename`, `creates`, `deletes`) and all seven destructuring sites are updated. *Rationale*: a positional tuple that grows a fourth and fifth element is the shape that rots; the tuple is purely internal (no JSON payload depends on its arity), so this is not a frozen-contract break.
